q_en:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.

Obsolete
q_hi:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.

Obsolete
solution:
Solution (EN): 'Obsolete' means no longer produced or used; out of date. The exact opposite is 'Current', which means belonging to the present time. 'Outdated' is a synonym of obsolete.
Solution (HI): 'Obsolete' का अर्थ है अप्रचलित या पुराना (जो अब उपयोग में न हो)। इसका विलोम (antonym) 'Current' (वर्तमान या जो चलन में हो) है। 'Outdated' इसका पर्यायवाची है।
Short Trick: Obsolete = Out of date. Opposite = Current.

q_en:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

A piece of cake
q_hi:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

A piece of cake
solution:
Solution (EN): The idiom 'a piece of cake' is used to describe a task, job, or activity that is very easy to accomplish.
Solution (HI): 'A piece of cake' मुहावरे का उपयोग किसी ऐसे काम या गतिविधि का वर्णन करने के लिए किया जाता है जिसे करना बहुत आसान हो (An easy task)।
Short Trick: Eating a piece of cake is very easy, hence it means 'an easy task'.

Solution (EN): The word 'Mischeivous' is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is 'Mischievous', which means causing or showing a fondness for causing trouble in a playful way.
Solution (HI): 'Mischeivous' की वर्तनी गलत है। सही वर्तनी 'Mischievous' (शरारती) है। 'i' पहले आता है और 'e' बाद में (ie)।

q_en:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A person who is indifferent to pleasure or pain
q_hi:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A person who is indifferent to pleasure or pain
solution:
Solution (EN): A 'Stoic' is a person who can endure pain or hardship without showing their feelings or complaining. A 'Cynic' doubts human motives, a 'Mystic' seeks spiritual truth, and an 'Epicure' is fond of sensual pleasure, especially food.
Solution (HI): 'Stoic' (तटस्थ/उदासीन) वह व्यक्ति होता है जिस पर सुख या दुख का कोई प्रभाव नहीं पड़ता। 'Cynic' निंदक होता है, और 'Epicure' स्वादलोलुप (खाने-पीने का शौकीन) होता है।
Short Trick: STOIC = Someone Tolerating Obstacles In Calmness.

q_en:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Lethargic
q_hi:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Lethargic
solution:
Solution (EN): 'Lethargic' means affected by lethargy; sluggish and apathetic. Therefore, 'Sluggish' is the correct synonym. 'Energetic' is its antonym.
Solution (HI): 'Lethargic' का अर्थ है सुस्त या आलसी। 'Sluggish' (सुस्त) इसका सबसे उपयुक्त पर्यायवाची है। 'Energetic' का अर्थ ऊर्जावान होता है।
Short Trick: Lethargic sounds like lacking energy = Sluggish.

Many individuals spend hours scrolling through feeds, which often (3) ______ their mental health. It is essential to strike a (4) ______ between online activities and real-life interactions. We must ensure that screens do not (5) ______ genuine human connections.

Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
Solution (EN): The passage talks about the massive impact of technology. 'Drastically' means in a way that is likely to have a strong or far-reaching effect, which fits the context of changing communication perfectly.
Solution (HI): गद्यांश तकनीक के बड़े प्रभाव के बारे में बात करता है। 'Drastically' का अर्थ है व्यापक रूप से या भारी पैमाने पर। तकनीक ने हमारे संचार के तरीके को व्यापक रूप से बदल दिया है।
Short Trick: Technology has brought a huge change, so 'drastically' (hugely) is the right word.

Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
Solution (EN): Smartphones and social media are tools for communication, thus they keep us 'connected' to people around the world. The word 'While' sets up a contrast with 'isolation' in the next clause.
Solution (HI): स्मार्टफोन और सोशल मीडिया हमें दुनिया भर के लोगों से 'connected' (जुड़ा हुआ) रखते हैं। अन्य विकल्प जैसे 'detached' (अलग) या 'distant' (दूर) यहाँ गलत अर्थ देंगे।
Short Trick: Social media -> keeps us in touch -> connected.

solution:
Solution (EN): The passage discusses the negative effects of excessive screen time (creating a sense of isolation). Therefore, spending hours scrolling 'damages' mental health. The other options are positive words.
Solution (HI): गद्यांश में स्क्रीन टाइम के नकारात्मक प्रभावों पर चर्चा की गई है। लगातार फीड स्क्रॉल करने से मानसिक स्वास्थ्य 'damages' (खराब) होता है। अन्य विकल्प सकारात्मक हैं जो यहाँ फिट नहीं बैठते।
Short Trick: Hours of scrolling + sense of isolation = Negative effect (damages).

solution:
Solution (EN): 'Strike a balance' is a common collocation meaning to choose a moderate course or compromise between two different things (here, online activities and real-life interactions).

Short Trick: The phrase is always "strike a balance between A and B".

Many individuals spend hours scrolling through feeds, which often (3) ______ their mental health. It is essential to strike a (4) ______ between online activities and real-life interactions. We must ensure that screens do not (5) ______ genuine human connections.

Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
Solution (EN): The sentence warns against letting technology take over completely. We must ensure screens do not 'replace' (take the place of) genuine human connections. The other options are positive and do not fit the warning tone ('do not...').
Solution (HI): वाक्य चेतावनी देता है कि हमें यह सुनिश्चित करना चाहिए कि स्क्रीन असली मानवीय संबंधों की 'replace' (जगह न ले) लें। अन्य विकल्प (encourage, build, support) सकारात्मक हैं और यहाँ फिट नहीं बैठते।
Short Trick: "Do not" requires a negative action in this context. Replacing human connection with screens is the negative action to avoid.
